data_fields.name: group_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: spawngroup group_spawn_limit (count of live NPCs in group)

data_fields.name: type_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: npc_types spawn_limit (count of live NPCs of that type in zone)

data_fields.name: type_limit_retry_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 5000 (retry when a unique or type cap blocks a spawn; not in sketch)

data_fields.name: default_despawn_timer_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 100000 (used when the despawn mode is not 1-4)

best_idea: A spawn point owns one timer: a respawn after death with a jittered delay, group and type caps checked at roll time, and a despawn timer that removes only an unengaged NPC and never a fight in progress.
decision_why: Row 23 needs exactly this shape (caps, respawn, grace despawn as zone data). Adapt because the donor's engaged path can leave two live NPCs at one point, its cadence is a separate 1 s pass not our fixed-step server tick, and 'engaged' is only a non-empty hate list; keep one NPC per point and drive the pass from the server tick.
acceptance: Server test: one point with respawn 60 s and variance 10 s; after its NPC dies a new NPC appears between 55 s and 65 s later; an engaged NPC past the despawn timer is still in the world and no second NPC appears at that point.
